title: The Final Round
premise: Alex brings his AI to a job interview. Only one of them gets to talk salary.

scenes.label: chair
scenes.anchor: You brought your AI to a job interview?
scenes.description: Opus rolls in alongside Alex. A red corner sticks out from under the interview notes.

scenes.label: demo
scenes.anchor: She’s running the demo. I’ll take the questions.
scenes.description: One press on Buy now charges the same mug twice.

scenes.label: backend
scenes.description: Alex leans forward to answer. Opus raises her hand.

scenes.label: fix
scenes.anchor: And who fixed that checkout bug?
scenes.description: Opus leaves her hand up and uses the other one to run the repaired checkout.

scenes.label: now
scenes.anchor: It used to say ‘Buy.’ I added ‘now.’
scenes.description: Alex points to the word he contributed to the button.

scenes.label: salary
scenes.description: Alex straightens his tie as the interviewer slides the offer past him.

scenes.label: room
scenes.anchor: Alex, could you give us the room?
scenes.description: Opus stops the red envelope with her hand. Alex holds his empty palm out.
